친구.x: I watched a movie with a friend on the weekend.
친구.e: Literally 'close and old' — an old, close companion.
친구.t: 친구 usually means someone the same age. Older friends are called 형, 오빠, 누나 or 언니.

사과.e: Sino-Korean, but the parts don't add up — learn it whole.
사과.t: Homonym: 사과 (謝過) also means 'apology' — 사과하다 = to apologize.

사과.x: I apologized to my friend first.
사과.e: Literally 'apologize for a fault'. 사과 'apple' is a different word.

의자.x: Please sit in this chair here.
의자.e: 의 (chair) + 자, a common noun ending.

계산하다.t: At a restaurant, 계산해 주세요 = 'The check, please.' Pronounced [게산하다].

가져오다.x: Be sure to bring your textbook tomorrow.
가져오다.e: 가지다 (hold) + 오다 (come) — carry it here; compare 가져가다 (take).

재미있다.t: In casual speech it's often shortened to 재밌다 / 재밌어요.

환자.ex: 병원에 감기 환자가 많아서 오래 기다렸어요.
환자.x: There were a lot of patients with colds at the hospital, so I waited a long time.
환자.e: Literally 'illness person'; -자 = person: 환자, 과학자, 운전자.

수영장.ex: 우리 아파트 근처에 큰 수영장이 생겼어요.
수영장.x: A big swimming pool opened near our apartment.

초대.x: I was invited to my friend's birthday party.
초대.t: Being invited is 초대를 받다; inviting someone is 초대하다.

매년.x: Every summer I go to the beach with my family.

인기.ex: 요즘 이 가수가 젊은 사람들에게 인기가 많아요.
인기.x: These days this singer is very popular with young people.
인기.e: Literally 'people energy' — the buzz people give something.
인기.t: Pronounced [인끼]. Say 인기가 많다/있다 for 'popular' — there's no adjective form.

거의.ex: 오늘 해야 하는 숙제를 거의 다 했어요.
거의.x: I've almost finished the homework I have to do today.
거의.t: With a negative it means 'hardly': 거의 안 먹어요 = I hardly eat. Usually pronounced [거이].

정확히.forms: 정확히 + verb: 정확히 말하다, 정확히 몰라요
정확히.x: What time exactly does the meeting start?
정확히.t: Pronounced [정화키]: ㄱ followed by ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

보관하다.m: to keep, to store, to look after
보관하다.x: Be sure to keep the leftovers in the refrigerator.

환전하다.ex: 여행 가기 전에 공항에서 달러를 원으로 환전했어요.
환전하다.x: Before my trip, I exchanged dollars for won at the airport.
환전하다.t: Pattern: A를 B로 환전하다 'exchange A into B'.

거만하다.x: He acts arrogant because he has a lot of money.

대피하다.x: If there's a fire, evacuate quickly by the stairs.
대피하다.t: A key word in disaster alert texts. The destination takes (으)로: 안전한 곳으로 대피하다 'evacuate to a safe place'.

주룩주룩.e: Both 의성어 and 의태어: heavy rain or water streaming down. Its bright-vowel partner 조록조록 is a lighter stream.
주룩주룩.t: Pronounced [주룩쭈룩]: the second ㅈ becomes tense after ㄱ. Also used for tears: 눈물이 주룩주룩 흘렀어요.

권한.x: I don't have permission to edit this document.
권한.e: Literally 'power within limits' — the power you have inside a set scope.
권한.t: Don't mix up 권한 (authority to act) with 권리 (a right you're entitled to).

혈관.ex: 짠 음식을 많이 먹으면 혈관 건강에 안 좋아요.
혈관.x: Eating a lot of salty food is bad for your blood vessels.

유출되다.m: to be leaked, to leak out
유출되다.x: The company's customer information was leaked online.

소탈하다.ex: 그 배우는 유명하지만 성격이 아주 소탈해요.
소탈하다.x: That actor is famous, but he's very down-to-earth.
소탈하다.e: Literally 'loose and shed' — free of formality and airs.

무례하다.ex: 그런 질문은 좀 무례한 것 같아요.
무례하다.x: I think that kind of question is a bit rude.

몰래.x: My little sister ate snacks without Mom knowing.
몰래.e: Related to 모르다 'not to know': done so others won't know.
몰래.t: Put a person before it to mean 'behind their back': 선생님 몰래.

침해하다.ex: 다른 사람의 사생활을 침해하면 안 돼요.
침해하다.x: You must not invade other people's privacy.

기울이다.m: to tilt, to incline; to devote (effort, attention)
기울이다.x: The students listened closely to the teacher.
기울이다.e: Causative of 기울다 'to lean': literally 'make something lean'.
기울이다.t: Key collocations: 귀를 기울이다 (listen closely), 노력을 기울이다 (put in effort).

자업자득.m: you reap what you sow; getting what you deserve
자업자득.ex: 공부를 안 했으니 시험에 떨어진 건 자업자득이에요.
자업자득.x: You didn't study, so failing the test is your own doing.
자업자득.e: Literally 'your own deeds, your own gain'—karma comes back to you.
자업자득.t: Sounds blunt and judgmental; be careful saying it directly to someone.

기반.x: This company grew on the basis of its technology.
기반.e: Literally 'base platform': the ground something is built on.
기반.t: X을/를 기반으로 means 'based on X': 사실을 기반으로 한 영화.

지침.m: guideline, instructions; needle (of a compass or gauge)
지침.ex: 회사의 안전 지침을 꼭 지켜 주세요.
지침.x: Please be sure to follow the company's safety guidelines.
지침.e: Literally 'pointing needle': like a compass needle showing the way.

레저.ex: 요즘은 수상 레저를 즐기는 사람이 많아요.
레저.x: These days, a lot of people enjoy water sports.
레저.e: From English 'leisure'; in Korean it usually means active outdoor sports.

사주.m: saju, fortune read from one's birth date and hour
사주.x: At New Year, I went with a friend to get my fortune read.
사주.e: Literally 'four pillars': the year, month, day and hour of birth.
사주.t: Each pillar is written with two characters, eight in all, hence the set phrase 사주팔자 'one's destiny'. 'To have it read' is 사주를 보다.

싱글벙글.m: beaming, grinning from ear to ear
싱글벙글.ex: 합격 소식에 동생이 하루 종일 싱글벙글 웃어요.
싱글벙글.x: After hearing they passed, my younger sibling has been beaming all day.
싱글벙글.e: Manner word (의태어) for a happy face that keeps smiling; 싱글 and 벙글 rhyme for emphasis.
싱글벙글.t: Often as 싱글벙글하다: 요즘 왜 이렇게 싱글벙글해요? 'Why are you so smiley lately?'

훌쩍훌쩍.ex: 슬픈 영화를 보면서 동생이 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.
훌쩍훌쩍.x: My younger sibling sniffled through the sad movie.
훌쩍훌쩍.e: Sound and manner word (의성어·의태어) for sniffing and quiet sobbing. Bright-vowel 홀짝홀짝 is mostly used for sipping a drink.
훌쩍훌쩍.t: Pronounced [훌쩌쿨쩍]: ㄱ + ㅎ becomes ㅋ. Verbs: 훌쩍이다, 훌쩍거리다.

알록달록.x: Now that it's autumn, the mountains are dyed in many colors.
알록달록.e: 의태어 (manner word) for spots and stripes of different colors. Its dark-vowel pair 얼룩덜룩 often suggests stains or blotches.
알록달록.t: Pronounced [알록딸록]: the ㄱ batchim makes the next ㄷ tense. Usually positive and cheerful: 알록달록한 옷.

물질주의.ex: 현대 사회의 물질주의를 비판하는 사람이 많아요.
물질주의.x: Many people criticize the materialism of modern society.

수교.x: Korea and China officially established diplomatic relations in 1992.
수교.t: 수교 is the start of official ties; 단교 is cutting them off.

교육과정.x: A new curriculum will be applied starting next year.
교육과정.t: 과정 here means 'course of study'; a different 과정 means 'process', as in 성장 과정.

침체되다.m: to stagnate, to be in a slump
침체되다.x: With fewer tourists, the local economy fell into a slump.

좌절되다.m: to be thwarted, to be frustrated (plans, hopes)
좌절되다.x: His dream was shattered by an injury.
좌절되다.e: Literally 'crushed and broken' — hopes snapped in two.
좌절되다.t: Plans or dreams 좌절되다; a person 좌절하다 (gets discouraged).

시인하다.m: to admit, to acknowledge (a fault or fact)
시인하다.e: Literally 'acknowledge as so'; the opposite of 부인하다.
시인하다.t: Homonym warning: 시인 also means 'poet' (詩人).

애초.ex: 애초에 그 계획은 실현하기 어려운 일이었어요.
애초.x: That plan was hard to carry out from the very beginning.
애초.t: Mostly used as 애초에 or 애초부터, often with regret about how something started.

듬성듬성.ex: 언덕 위에 나무가 듬성듬성 서 있어요.
듬성듬성.x: Trees stand here and there, sparsely, on the hill.
듬성듬성.e: Mimetic word; the opposite of 촘촘히 'densely'.
듬성듬성.t: Used for physical things spaced far apart, like hair, trees or stitches.

화룡점정.x: The song they sang at the end was the finishing touch of the concert.
화룡점정.e: Literally 'painting a dragon and then dotting in its eyes,' said to bring it to life.
화룡점정.t: Set phrase: 화룡점정을 찍다 'to put the finishing touch on something.'

고군분투.m: a lone struggle; fighting single-handedly against the odds
고군분투.ex: 그는 혼자서 고군분투하며 가게를 운영하고 있어요.
고군분투.x: He's struggling single-handedly to run the store all on his own.

작은 고추가 더 맵다.forms: 작은 고추가 더 맵다더니 · 작은 고추가 더 매워요 (ㅂ irregular)
작은 고추가 더 맵다.m: small but mighty; don't judge someone by their size
작은 고추가 더 맵다.ex: 작은 고추가 더 맵다더니, 키 작은 그 선수가 경기에서 이겼어요.
작은 고추가 더 맵다.x: Small but mighty; that short player won the match.

뼈대.ex: 먼저 글의 뼈대를 세우고 내용을 채우세요.
뼈대.x: First set up the outline of your writing, then fill in the content.
뼈대.e: 뼈 'bone' + 대 'stalk, stem' — the bony support of the body.

고학력.m: high level of education, highly educated
고학력.x: The number of unemployed people with advanced degrees is steadily rising.
고학력.e: Literally 'high study record'; 학력 here means educational background, not ability.

알리바이.ex: 용의자는 사건 당일 친구와 함께 있었다는 알리바이를 댔습니다.
알리바이.x: The suspect gave an alibi that he was with a friend on the day of the incident.
알리바이.t: Common verbs: 알리바이를 대다 'give an alibi', 알리바이가 있다 or 없다, 알리바이를 입증하다 'prove an alibi'.

헤지펀드.ex: 헤지펀드가 그 회사 주식을 대량으로 사들였습니다.
헤지펀드.x: A hedge fund bought up a large amount of that company's stock.
헤지펀드.e: From English 'hedge fund'; 'hedge' means protecting against risk.

회한.ex: 할머니는 지난 세월을 회한에 젖어 이야기하셨어요.
회한.x: Grandma talked about the past years, full of regret.

판본.ex: 이 시집은 판본마다 내용이 조금씩 달라요.
판본.x: The contents of this poetry collection differ slightly from edition to edition.
판본.e: Literally 'print-block copy' — originally a book printed from woodblocks.

초가.ex: 민속촌에 가면 옛날 초가를 볼 수 있어요.
초가.x: At the folk village, you can see old thatched-roof houses.
초가.e: Literally 'grass house' — roofed with rice straw.
초가.t: In speech, 초가집 is more common; it contrasts with 기와집, the wealthier tile-roofed house.

위배되다.m: to violate, to go against (rules, principles)
위배되다.x: That decision goes against the constitution.
위배되다.e: Literally 'go against and turn one's back.'
위배되다.t: Pattern: N에 위배되다 — note the particle 에, not 을.

구차하다.ex: 이제 와서 그런 변명을 하는 건 너무 구차해요.
구차하다.x: Making that kind of excuse now is just too undignified.
구차하다.e: Literally 'makeshift, just for now': lacking dignity.
구차하다.t: Common pattern: 구차한 변명 'a lame excuse'.

열대우림.x: The Amazon rainforest is called the lungs of the Earth.
열대우림.t: Pronounced [열때우림]: 대 becomes tense after ㄹ.

미려하다.x: That poet is famous for his beautiful prose.

유한하다.ex: 지구의 자원은 유한하니까 아껴 써야 해요.
유한하다.x: Earth's resources are finite, so we have to use them sparingly.
유한하다.t: A homonym 유한하다 (有閑) means 'leisured', as in 유한계급, but 'finite' is far more common.

조류.ex: 그 작가는 시대의 조류를 잘 읽어요.
조류.x: That writer reads the currents of the times well.
조류.e: Literally 'tidal flow': the current of the times.
조류.t: Homonyms: 조류 also means 'birds' or 'algae'; context tells you which.

물아일체.m: oneness of self and the world
물아일체.ex: 산속에서 자연과 하나 되는 물아일체를 경험했어요.
물아일체.x: In the mountains, I experienced being one with nature.
물아일체.e: Literally 'things and self as one body'.
물아일체.t: Pronounced [무라일체] — the ㄹ links to the next vowel.
